text:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: org=Lunatech severity=high spike in write QPS, 99th latency > 2s, error-rate 4%. Investigate and mitigate.

sre_oncall_2: I'm on it. joining call. pulling metrics now. can someone confirm customer impact?

alice_nguyen: CS says Lunatech reports timeouts for batch uploads, affecting checkout flows. Customer on PRO tier.

raj_patel: looking at traces — large fanout from a scheduled job at 09:02 UTC, sustained token burst. Requests look legit (no auth failures).

marie_chen: thundering herd on a specific route `/api/v1/generate/bulk`. QPS jumped from 40 -> 1200 in 2m.

support_pager: Notified Lunatech support contact (via email) that we're investigating, asked for whether this is expected.

kevin_ops: we should avoid a global throttle. propose temporary per-org adaptive throttle and increase org quota for Lunatech until they patch.

sre_oncall_2: Agreed. Let's do emergency soft bump + adaptive shaping. Plan: 1) enable org bypass up to 800 QPS with token-level shaping, 2) add prefix-based KV cache for bulk requests, 3) put a short TTL backpressure if latency > 1s.

alice_nguyen: +1. I'm ready to run the admin command. Will document audit reason.

raj_patel: tagging ops checklist. watch for tail-latency and mem pressure. If KV cache misses spike, rollback.

sre_oncall_2: Running command now:

```
# temporary org throttle adjustment
adminctl org update-rate --org lunatech --qps 800 --burst 1600 --mode adaptive --reason "prod spike 2026-03-15; temporary hotfix; paging follow-up"
```

inc-bot: Command executed by alice_nguyen at 2367890148. AuditID: AUD-8f3a2.

marie_chen: Metrics: latency dropping at 09:04 UTC, 99th from 2.2s -> 0.9s in 90s. Error-rate down to 0.6%. CPU on inference pool up ~15%.

kevin_ops: Can we enable prefix-level caching for the bulk route? I'll flip the feature flag `enable_prefix_cache.bulk_route` briefly.

alice_nguyen: flipping feature flag: `ffctl set enable_prefix_cache.bulk_route true --env prod`

inc-bot: Feature flag toggled by alice_nguyen at 2367890162.

raj_patel: Cache hit rate climbing, tail latency improved. No KV OOMs observed.

support_pager: Lunatech confirmed reduced failures, thanks. They say internal job will be reconfigured in next deploy.

sre_oncall_2: Good. Two follow-ups: 1) Schedule postmortem with Lunatech and CS to discuss rate limits and backoffs. 2) Add a long-term guard: detect scheduled bulk jobs and recommend client-side rate limiting.

marie_chen: I'll create an alert rule to detect sudden fanout by origin IP and route; propose a canary threshold so we can auto-soft-throttle next time.

kevin_ops: Also add a billing note for the temporary bump — finance needs to reconcile.

alice_nguyen: Rolling rollback plan ready. If CPU or error-rate rises again, run:

```
adminctl org update-rate --org lunatech --qps 200 --burst 400 --mode standard --reason "rollback due to resource pressure"
```

sre_oncall_2: No need to rollback now. Keeping adaptive throttle in place for 30m. Will handoff to night SRE at +2h.

support_pager: Noted. CS to follow up with customer post-incident.

raj_patel: Posting short incident summary to #incidents-wg once we have full logs.

inc-bot: Handoff reminder set for 2367897323.

alice_nguyen: tagging for postmortem: @marie_chen (triage), @raj_patel (traces), @kevin_ops (ops/flags), @support_pager (customer).

marie_chen: Adding notes to the incident doc now. I'll include the audit IDs and commands.

sre_oncall_2: Closing the thread for now; keep monitoring. If any regression, reopen. :thumbsup:
